title: Aureline M5 migration scoreboard delta
description: Canonical per-domain scoreboard-delta record minted by the migration-scoreboard and scoreboard-delta lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Turns a change in an active supported line's published, versioned migration scoreboard into a visible, machine-checkable periodic delta instead of an anecdotal support thread: it records the delta scope a scoreboard change sits in — a field-pain cluster (post-launch field pain is clustering in an importer / bridge outcome class or source archetype versus the last published scoreboard), an unsupported-category growth (the unsupported source-item categories are accumulating against the last scoreboard), or a docs/help-or-rollback gap (a docs/help parity gap or rollback failure is accumulating after launch versus the last scoreboard). Names the delta scope, binds the resolved supported-line identity, the affected scoreboard-section reference, the previous-versus-current scoreboard reference, and the active delta reason so docs/help/migration owners, support, and procurement surfaces can identify concrete deltas between the last published scoreboard and the current one without reconstructing data manually, and can narrow replacement-grade or daily-driver language on scoreboard data rather than anecdotal support threads. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's migration posture by hand. Public-safe and internal-only variants share one canonical record identity; raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
